Mr. Charles H-. Slack may be reinstated to the position of compositor
at fifty cents per hour in the Government Printing ( )ffice without reference
to the period of his separation from the service.
Mr. Slack was appointed in the Government Printing Office Decem-
ber 3, 1901, and resigned September 23, 1904. A certificate was requested
for his reinstatement within the year of his eligi'i lity and wvas issued by
this office, but it was returned unused by the Public Printer February 27,
1906.
